label: Promo highlight hook (marker headline)
description: Carousel-ad opener on a light frame: a brand logo top-left, a display headline where <em> spans render as an accent marker-highlight pill, a plain subtitle, and a full-width baked art canvas anchored to the bottom edge. Extends the promo-* family (1080x1920) with the --brand-accent token (lime fallback from the Vidext 'Carrusel señales' reference).
